nom: Clinique Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Gel Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone report the gel hydrates effectively without adding shine, excess oil, or breakouts.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin report significant relief from tightness and flakiness, several specifically switching from heavier or pricier moisturizers. A couple of reviewers, however, including one who says explicitly it is not suited to true dry skin, report it did not moisturize at all or left a sticky film without absorbing.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin, including combination-oily, report it balances and hydrates well; one reviewer, however, reports it causes pimples for her regardless of the season, on and off over several years.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea, eczema, or multiple allergies, report this is one of the few moisturizers that doesn't irritate or break them out. One reviewer, however, reports it caused a burning rash on two separate occasions.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report soft, dewy, refreshed-looking skin with regular use; one older reviewer finds it not moisturizing enough for what she calls her 'senior' skin's needs.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across a wide range of ages and skin types, report significant, long-lasting hydration, often describing plumper, more comfortable skin through the day. A minority, however, report the opposite: for a few reviewers, including one with true dry skin, it did not moisturize at all or left a sticky film without real absorption, and a couple say they still need to layer a heavier product on top.
concerns.redness: Reviewers managing rosacea, eczema, or psoriasis report calmer, less red or irritated skin with regular use, including one who specifically notes her rosacea-related redness declining over time. One reviewer, however, reports the product caused a burning rash on two separate occasions.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report visible improvement in fine lines with regular use, including one who credits it with smoothing the fine lines that appear when her skin gets dehydrated; this is not the central focus of most reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who say other moisturizers make them break out, report this one does not cause breakouts. A minority, however, report the opposite: new or painful breakouts, with one reviewer suspecting a recent reformulation and another reporting it happens every time she uses it over several years.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers, including several with oily or combination-oily skin, consistently report the gel absorbs without a greasy or oily film; no reviewer in this set reports it making their skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Sits well under makeup and SPF
Small amount goes a long way
Can pill when layered with other products
Pricey at full price, best bought on sale

extraits.texte: I was told this stuff is amazing but I don't have acne until I use this. I've tried on & off for a couple years. I have combination skin, oiler in summer dryer in winter and it doesn't matter when I use it. You can feel that it's just lying on the skin's surface & not penetrating it. I'm not sure what the hype is about. There's nothing hydrating about this for me. Just pimples. I would recommend the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion+ or Dramatically Different Hydrating Jelly. These feel way more natural, hydrating and my skin isn't gross after using them.

Really like that Moisture Surge doesn't have a strong fragrance and that it's reasonably priced. Unfortunately, it caused my face to break out in a burning rash. Waited a few months and just tried it again because meh...what if it was me? Nah, Same thing happened. Really like the product but we weren't meant to be.

extraits.titre: Not worth the money, not for truly dry skin
extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this but any time I wear it it feels like it doesn't absorb and leaves a sticky feel to my face. My skin is dry and I don't think this product is best suited for true dry skin.

I LOVE this product. I dont know what I would do without her!! I am 21 years old, I have skin that is easily allergic to a lot of products, and have rosacea. I also get extremely dry skin year round that cracks and starts to burn. I have tried lathering myself in aquaphor and many different moisturizers but nothing works like this product. I put her on and she is ready to put makeup over in less than 3 minutes, and she doesn't cause my makeup to pill, which I love because both this moisturizer and my bb cream are water based. On my no makeup days, I only need to apply her once in the morning, and in the past I would need to reapply moisturizers almost 3 times a day. Like I mentioned above, I struggle with redness in the cheek area from rosacea and have noticed that going down signifigantly since I started using this product. It is so calming, hydrating, easy to use, and really lives up to its name. The only con is how expensive it is but it is definently worth it to claim any sales going on to give her a try! I don't know how my skin lived before this product!!
This cream-gel has become the best moisturizer for my oily skin. I can't be without it.
I love Moisture Surge so much because it leaves my 74 year old skin dewy and soft. It doesn't leave an oily film like other moisture products. Have used for about 5 years now. Can't go without it!

I am absolutely obsessed with Clinique's Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator. From the very first use, my skin felt instantly refreshed, plump, and deeply hydrated—like it had a full glass of water. The texture is lightweight and gel-like, so it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. I love that it's oil-free, which makes it perfect for everyday use, even under makeup. My skin stays soft and dewy all day, and I've noticed a real improvement in dryness and fine lines over time. What really stands out is how soothing it feels—especially when my skin is stressed or dehydrated. It gives that immediate cooling, calming effect that just feels amazing. If you're looking for a moisturizer that delivers long-lasting hydration and a healthy glow, this is 100% worth it. It's become a staple in my skincare routine and I honestly can't imagine going without it now.
